turns.assessment: The hard, simultaneous loss is localized to the S16-adjacent physical span of the S03–S16 line: OSC is lost on oms.S03-S16.span2 and on its opposite-direction counterpart oms.S16-S03.span0, while the downstream amplifier reports input LOS. Unchanged pump currents argue against amplifier failure, and loss in both directions argues strongly against a single ROADM-to-booster patch or WSS fault. The simultaneous analogous failure toward S07 suggests a common cable/duct incident near S16.

proposals.rationale: This is the S16-adjacent span on the S03-to-S16 direction and is the same physical cable section represented by oms.S16-S03.span0 in the reverse direction. Bidirectional OSC loss, amplifier input LOS, and widespread OCH LOS are the characteristic hard-loss pattern of a fibre cut. This directly interrupts svc379's S03-S16 lightpath.
A sufficiently severe bend, crushed cable, or splice failure could lose both payload and OSC, but the abrupt complete LOS pattern favors a cut.
Recent maintenance at S16 makes a pulled patch possible, but an OMS-input patch failure would principally affect the outgoing direction and does not adequately explain reverse-direction OSC loss.
The S16 ROADM is a common dependency, but a WSS input-port failure would not normally remove the OSC on the adjoining fibre spans or produce this bidirectional line-loss pattern.
